headline: Singapore Exchange CEO Loh Boon Chye to Step Down in 2027
summary: Singapore Exchange chief executive Loh Boon Chye, who has led SGX since 2015, announced plans to step down in 2027, citing sufficient time for a smooth succession.
why: SGX is a core financial hub for Southeast Asian equities, derivatives, and fixed-income clearing.

impacts.name: Singapore Exchange Limited
impacts.why: Leadership change announced well in advance maintains operational continuity.
